blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reconstructing complete, high-quality meshes of large-scale scenes from unposed multi-view images requires faithful geometric grounding while plausibly completing surfaces that are unobserved or only sparsely captured. We present WorldRecon, a generative multi-view reconstruction framework for recovering complete, large-scale 3D scene meshes from unposed RGB images. WorldRecon uses a coarse, noisy global point cloud and camera poses estimated from the input images by a reconstruction model as a global scaffold for whole-scene generation and partitions it into overlapping spatial blocks. To robustly leverage these imperfect geometric priors, we equip the native 3D generative model TRELLIS.2 with a dedicated reconstruction-based conditioning architecture that generates each block from its local point-cloud crop and block-relevant image observations, producing sparse structure, detailed geometry, and PBR materials. To maintain scene-level coherence, we introduce neighbour-aware latent inpainting and a causal world-generation procedure that propagates structural, geometric, and material context across overlapping blocks. Together, these designs scale multi-view generative reconstruction to large-scale scenes, yielding coherent, unified meshes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that WorldRecon achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction performance, reducing Chamfer distance by 14.9% and 43.1% while improving F-score by 17.3% and 12.0% over the strongest baselines on synthetic and real-world indoor scenes, respectively, thereby demonstrating faithful and complete generative reconstruction as well as strong sim-to-real generalization. Project page: https://kszpxxzmc.github.io/WorldRecon-website/.
blocks.zh: 从无位多视图图像中再造出完整,高品质的大型场景网格,需要忠实的几何地平面,而巧妙地完成无法观察或仅被稀有地捕获的地表. 我们介绍的是WorldRecon,一个基因多视图重建框架,用于从未显示的RGB图像中恢复完整,大规模的3D场景间隙. WorldRecon使用一个粗糙,吵闹的全球点云和相机,从重建模型的输入图像中估算出来,作为全景生成的全球脚手架,并将其分割成相重叠的空间块. 为了有力地利用这些不完善的几何前缀,我们为本地的3D基因模型TRELLIS.2配备了专用的以重建为基础的取材结构,从它的局部点-云作物和与块相关的图像观测中生成出每个块,产生稀疏的结构,详细的几何和PBR材料. 为了保持场景层面的一致性,我们引入了了解邻居潜在油漆和因果世界生成程序,将结构、几何和物质背景传播到相互重叠的街区。 这些设计共同将多景基因重建规模扩大到了大规模场景,产生了连贯,统一的网格. 广泛的实验表明,世界Recon实现了最先进的重建性能,将Chamfer的距离减少了14.9%和43.1%,同时在合成和现实世界室内场景上,F分数分别比最强的基线提高17.3%和12.0%,从而展示了忠实而完整的基因重建以及强烈的平面到现实的通化. 项目网页:https://kszpxxzmc.github.io/WorldRecon-website/.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recovering a large-scale scene from unposed RGB images is a fundamental problem in computer vision, with broad applications in virtual and augmented reality, embodied intelligence, and digital content production. Reconstruction-based methods Wang et al. (2024) ; Leroy et al. (2024) ; Wang et al. (2026) ; Barron et al. (2022) ; Yu et al. (2022) ; Kerbl et al. (2023) recover scene geometry from visual observations, but often leave occluded regions incomplete and produce noisy geometry that is difficult to convert into clean meshes with detailed surfaces and materials.
blocks.zh: 从无法携带的RGB图像中恢复一个大规模场景是计算机视觉中的一个基本问题,在虚拟和增强现实中具有广泛的应用,包含智能,数字内容制作. 以重建为基础的方法 Wang等人(2024年);Leroy等人(2024年);Wang等人(2026年);Barron等人(2022年);Yu等人(2022年);Kerbl等人(2023年)从视觉观测中恢复场景几何,但经常留下被遮蔽的区域不完整,并产生噪音几何,难以转化为带有详细表面和材料的清洁的网状体.

blocks.en: Generative priors improve reconstruction completeness by inferring plausible geometry and appearance beyond the observations. Building on native 3D generative models Xiang et al. (2025) ; Xiang et al. (2026) ; Zhang et al. (2024) , recent multi-view extensions Chang et al. (2025) ; Huang et al. (2026) directly reconstruct structured 3D assets from unposed RGB images. Extending these methods to scene scale, however, remains challenging as the spatial extent and geometric complexity of an environment exceed the capacity of a single high-resolution generative representation.
blocks.zh: 遗传学前科通过推断观测以外的几何和外观,提高了重建的完整性。 以原生的3D基因模型为基础,Xiang等人(2025年);Xiang等人(2026年);Zhang等人(2024年),近期多观点扩展. 张等人(2025); 黄等. (2026)直接从未放置的RGB图像重建结构化的3D资产. 然而,将这些方法扩大到场景规模仍然具有挑战性,因为环境的空间范围和几何复杂性超过了单一高分辨率基因代表的能力。

blocks.en: Recent scene generation methods Chen et al. (2025) ; Wu et al. (2024b) ; Meng et al. (2025) ; Li et al. (2026) ; Engstler et al. (2025) scale to substantially larger environments by decomposing a scene into overlapping spatial blocks and generating them jointly or progressively. However, they are typically conditioned on text or layouts and thus lack visual guidance and 3D spatial grounding. More closely related to our task, scene-level generative reconstruction methods represent large scenes using hierarchical voxel latents Ren et al. (2024) or overlapping scene chunks Schmid et al. (2026) . However, they require accurate camera poses to project image features into a 3D feature volume, making reconstruction quality sensitive to pose errors.
blocks.zh: 近期场景生成方法 Chen等人(2025);Wu等人(2024b); Meng等人(2025年);Li等人(2026年);Engstler等人(2025年)通过将一个场景分解成重叠的空间块,并联合或逐步生成这些场景,从而达到大得多的环境. 然而,它们通常以文字或布局为条件,因此缺乏视觉指导和三维空间定位。 与我们的任务更紧密地联系在一起的是,场景层面的基因重建方法代表了大型场景,使用等级的voxel潜质Ren等人(2024年)或重叠场景块Schmid等人(2026年). 然而,它们需要精确的相机姿势,才能将图像特性投射到3D特性体积中,使重建质量敏感,从而造成错误.

blocks.en:
In this work, we introduce WorldRecon, a generative multi-view framework for reconstructing large-scale scene meshes from unposed RGB images. We employ VGGT- Ω \Omega Wang et al. (2026) to estimate coarse camera poses and recover a global point-cloud scaffold, which we partition into overlapping blocks. Our reconstruction-based conditioning leverages local point-cloud crops and block-relevant image observations, enabling the generation of complete, high-fidelity mesh blocks with PBR materials from imperfect geometric and camera estimates.
To promote consistency across blocks, we train neighbour-aware latent inpainting models that condition each new block on overlap latents from previously generated neighbours. At inference, we progressively expand the scene following a causal block order, propagating sparse structure, geometry, and material context through shared world representations. This enables neighbouring blocks to transition seamlessly in both geometry and appearance before being decoded and assembled into a unified scene mesh.

为促进各区块的一致性,我们培训了了解邻国潜在油漆模型,这些模型将每个新区块与以前产生的邻国的重叠潜在区块作为条件。 推论一下,我们逐渐扩大场景,遵循一个因果块顺序,通过共享的世界表示来宣传稀疏的结构,几何和物质背景. 这使得相邻的块能够在几何和外观上无缝过渡,然后解码并组装成统一的场景网.

blocks.en: Extensive experiments on 3D-FRONT Fu et al. (2021) and ScanNet++ Yeshwanth et al. (2023) demonstrate that WorldRecon reconstructs globally accurate and complete indoor scenes with fine geometric and material details from unposed RGB images on both synthetic and real-world settings.

blocks.en: In summary, our main contributions are as follows: • We present WorldRecon, a framework that integrates 3D reconstruction and generation to recover large-scale, high-fidelity scene meshes with PBR materials from unposed multi-view RGB images. • We develop reconstruction-based block generation with neighbour-aware inpainting, producing faithful mesh blocks from local observations and imperfect geometric and camera estimates. • We propose a causal world-generation pipeline that propagates sparse structure, geometry, and material context across overlapping blocks for scalable and seamless scene generation. • Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance in large-scale mesh reconstruction from unposed multi-view images across synthetic and real-world indoor scenes.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Multi-View 3D Reconstruction. Traditional 3D reconstruction relies on Structure-from-Motion Schonberger and Frahm (2016) ; Pan et al. (2024) and Multi-View Stereo Furukawa and Hernández (2015) ; Schönberger et al. (2016) to recover camera poses and scene geometry through triangulation.
Learning-based MVS methods Yao et al. (2018) ; Yao et al. (2019) ; Wang et al. (2021a) further improve quality and efficiency via differentiable cost volumes.
More recently, pose-free models Wang et al. (2024) ; Leroy et al. (2024) ; Wang et al. (2025) ; Wang et al. (2026) cast the pairwise reconstruction problem as a regression of pointmaps, jointly regressing cameras and dense geometry.
Beyond discrete point clouds, Neural Radiance Fields Mildenhall et al. (2021) ; Wang et al. (2021c) ; Barron et al. (2022) reframe reconstruction as inverse volumetric rendering for photorealistic view synthesis.
Neural implicit surface methods Wang et al. (2021b) ; Yariv et al. (2021) ; Yu et al. (2022) represent scenes as continuous signed-distance functions.
3D Gaussian Splatting Kerbl et al. (2023) ; Huang et al. (2024) ; Charatan et al. (2024) optimize scenes via differentiable rasterization for fast rendering.
However, these methods suffer from incomplete reconstruction and tend to produce over‑smooth, blurred details in occluded regions.

blocks.en:
Generative Multi-View 3D Reconstruction. Generative priors are introduced in multi-view 3D reconstruction to mitigate reconstructive incompleteness.
Early efforts Liu et al. (2024) ; Gao et al. (2024) ; Wu et al. (2024a) ; Guo et al. (2025) ; Xu et al. (2025) leverage 2D or video diffusion priors to synthesize novel views or
depth maps, but still require per-scene optimization and suffer from cross-view inconsistency.
Other works Jin et al. (2024) ; Tang et al. (2024b) ; Ziwen et al. (2025) regress target-view pixels or
3D Gaussians in a single feed-forward pass, but output unstructured primitives rather than meshes.
Recently, native 3D generative models Xiang et al. (2025) ; Xiang et al. (2026) ; Zhang et al. (2024) have enabled direct mesh generation from image conditioning.
ReconViaGen Chang et al. (2025) and UniRecGen Huang et al. (2026) extend
this paradigm to multi-view conditioning, but remain confined to the
object level. SCube Ren et al. (2024) and GenRecon Schmid et al. (2026) further extend multi-view 3D reconstruction to the scene level, yet both rely on accurate camera poses to project image features into a 3D feature volume, which induces cross-view conflicts and degrades reconstruction quality under imperfect poses.
In contrast, our method conditions on pose-free RGB images, recovering coherent scene mesh block-by-block via a native 3D generative prior.

对比之下,我们的方法条件 在无姿势的RGB图像, 恢复连贯的场景 网格-逐块 通过本地的3D基因前。

blocks.en:
Unbounded 3D Scene Generation. Extending 3D generation from objects to unbounded scenes has recently drawn increasing attention. Early efforts focus on bounded environments such as a single room, either retrieving assets from a fixed database Tang et al. (2024a) ; Wang et al. (2021d) , or hallucinating RGB-D frames with 2D diffusion models under text or layout conditions Höllein et al. (2023) ; Schult et al. (2024) .
To scale beyond bounded rooms, recent works pursue unbounded scene generation via block-wise generation, where neighbouring blocks are either jointly denoised and seamlessly blended Chen et al. (2025) , or progressively synthesized by an extrapolation prior Wu et al. (2024b) ; Meng et al. (2025) ; Li et al. (2026) ; Engstler et al. (2025) .
However, these methods are either unconditional or conditioned only on text or layout, lacking both visual guidance and 3D spatial grounding.
Our method instead grounds the scene in a coarse predicted point cloud and conditions each block on a few multi-view images, scaling multi-view generative reconstruction to arbitrarily large scenes.
blocks.zh:
无限三维场景世代. 将3D生成从物体扩展到无约束场景,最近引起了越来越多的关注. 早期工作的重点是诸如单间房等有界限的环境,或者从固定数据库Tang等人(2024a)中收回资产; Wang et al. (2021d),或幻觉在文本或布局条件下使用2D扩散模型的RGB-D帧 Höllein et al. (2023); Schult et al. (2024).
为了扩大范围,近期的作品通过区块设计进行无限制的场景制作,相邻的区块要么联合去声,要么无缝混合 Chen等人(2025年),或由吴等人(2024年b)之前的推论逐步合成; Meng等人(2025年);Li等人(2026年);Engstler等人(2025年).
然而,这些方法要么是无条件的,要么只是以文字或布局为条件,既缺乏视觉指导,又缺乏3D空间定位.
我们的方法将场景建立在粗糙的预测点云中,每个街区的条件都建立在几幅多景图像上,将多景基因重建缩放到任意的大场景上.

blocks.en: 3 WorldRecon Method
blocks.zh: 3 世界调试方法

blocks.en:
Given an arbitrary number of uncalibrated RGB images { I n } n = 1 N \{I_{n}\}_{n=1}^{N} of a large-scale indoor scene, our goal is to recover a complete, high-fidelity, scene-level 3D mesh endowed with PBR materials.
Our generative multi-view reconstruction framework couples a reconstruction prior for global layout consistency with a generative prior for surface fidelity and completeness.
To this end, we curate a block-level training dataset ( Section 3.1 ). We finetune the object-level generative prior of TRELLIS.2 Xiang et al. (2026) into a block-level mesh generator conditioned on each block’s point-cloud slice and multi-view RGBA images, together with a neighbour-aware 3D inpainting variant ( Section 3.2 ). At inference, we first extract a global point cloud with VGGT- Ω \Omega Wang et al. (2026) as a coarse geometric layout cue and partition it into overlapping point cloud blocks. Starting from a seed block, we sequentially generate the remaining blocks across three generation stages, conditioning each block on its overlaps with already-generated neighbours ( Section 3.3 ). The overall pipeline is shown in Figure 2 .
In this way, the point-cloud scaffold pins the scene to the observed geometry, while the block-wise generative prior fills in complete, high-fidelity surfaces.

我们的基因多视角重建框架是先于全球布局的重建,再于表面忠诚和完整性的基因。
为此,我们整理了区级培训数据集(第3.1节)。 我们微调TRELLIS 2 之前的对象级基因。 Xiang等人(2026年)在每一区块的点-云切片和多视图的RGBA图像上,加上一个邻居-意识到的3D涂装变体(第3.2节),成为区块级网格生成器。 推论,我们首先提取一个带有 VGGT- ship 的全局点云 \ Omega Wang et al. (20 commerce ,作为粗几何布局,将其分割为重叠点云块). 从种子块开始,我们依次生成三个代阶段的剩余块,以每个块与已经产生的邻居的重叠为条件(第3.3节)。 整个管道如图2所示。
这样,点云脚手架将场景钉在被观测到的几何上,而块状基因前置则填充了完整,高真实度的表面.

blocks.en: 3.1 Data Curation
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 数据校正

blocks.en:
Scene Slicing. To enable block-level scene generation, we first construct a structured, scalable 3D block dataset. We build on two synthetic indoor scene datasets, 3D-FRONT Fu et al. (2021) and SAGE-10k Xia et al. (2026) , which together cover diverse layouts, furniture styles, and material distributions.
For each scene, we render RGBD views from randomised eye-level cameras under varied lighting.
We then propose a scene-slicing strategy. The scene is partitioned into a regular grid of canonically oriented cubic blocks with side length ℓ \ell , each covering the full vertical extent of the scene. This yields roughly 56 ​ k 56\text{k} blocks from 6 ​ k 6\text{k} 3D-FRONT scenes and 61 ​ k 61\text{k} blocks from 10 ​ k 10\text{k} SAGE-10k scenes, totalling around 117 ​ k 117\text{k} training blocks. Each mesh block is normalised to canonical [ − 0.5 , 0.5 ] 3 [-0.5,0.5]^{3} space.

Generative Prior. We build on TRELLIS.2 Xiang et al. (2026) , an image-to-3D generation model that represents 3D asset as a sparse voxel structure termed O-Voxel , defined as a set of feature tuples 𝐟 = { ( 𝐟 i geo , 𝐟 i mat , 𝐨 i ) } i = 1 L \mathbf{f}=\{(\mathbf{f}^{\text{geo}}_{i},\,\mathbf{f}^{\text{mat}}_{i},\,\mathbf{o}_{i})\}_{i=1}^{L} over L L active voxels on a regular G 3 G^{3} grid, where 𝐨 i \mathbf{o}_{i} denotes the voxel position, 𝐟 i geo \mathbf{f}^{\text{geo}}_{i} encodes local geometric information, and 𝐟 i mat \mathbf{f}^{\text{mat}}_{i} encodes material properties.
Generation cascades three DiT flow-matching stages: Sparse Structure predicts the active-voxel positions { 𝐨 i } \{\mathbf{o}_{i}\} . Geometry predicts geometry latents 𝐳 geo \mathbf{z}^{\text{geo}} within active voxels, which are decoded into { 𝐟 i geo } \{\mathbf{f}^{\text{geo}}_{i}\} . Material synthesizes material latents 𝐳 mat \mathbf{z}^{\text{mat}} aligned to 𝐳 geo \mathbf{z}^{\text{geo}} , decoded to { 𝐟 i mat } \{\mathbf{f}^{\text{mat}}_{i}\} .
We finetune all three stages from the pretrained object-level TRELLIS.2 for block-level scene generation, replacing its original single-image conditioning with our reconstruction-based conditioning as detailed below.

Point Cloud Condition. Recovering geometry from RGB alone is inherently ambiguous, especially at scene scale where sparse views cover only partial structure. We therefore condition the Sparse Structure stage on a point cloud that supplies coarse spatial structure.
Following the Hunyuan3D-Omni Team (2025) design, each point of 𝒫 b = { 𝐩 j } j = 1 M \mathcal{P}_{b}=\{\mathbf{p}_{j}\}_{j=1}^{M} is encoded by a Fourier positional embedder followed by a linear projection, and K K learnable modality tokens are appended to form the point-cloud condition 𝐜 pc \mathbf{c}^{\text{pc}} .
Point-cloud tokens are randomly dropped during training, allowing classifier-free guidance to support both point-free and point-conditioned inference.

To retain the priors of our block-level generation models, we initialise each inpaint variant from its corresponding generation model.
The original input projection is directly inherited, while the projection weights associated with the additional C + 1 C{+}1 inpainting channels are zero-initialised. At the start of finetuning, the inpaint variant is thus functionally equivalent to the base generator, providing a stable initialisation for optimisation.

The mask configurations cover the 1 1 - and 2 2 -neighbour cases encountered under our voxel-priority generation ordering ( Section 3.3 ).
The known margin along each edge is sampled between 3 ​ ℓ / 16 3\ell/16 and ℓ / 4 \ell/4 .
At inference, we shrink the raw overlap of width ℓ / 4 \ell/4 by one quarter, leaving a known margin of 3 ​ ℓ / 16 3\ell/16 and an editable transition band of width ℓ / 16 \ell/16 . This design preserves sufficient neighbour context for cross-block consistency while allowing the model to adjust geometric and material transitions near block boundaries.

blocks.en: Given an arbitrary number of uncalibrated RGB images { I n } n = 1 N \{I_{n}\}_{n=1}^{N} , our inference pipeline generates a large-scale 3D mesh through block-based, neighbour-aware latent inpainting and overlap blending.

blocks.en:
Block Preparation. We run VGGT- Ω \Omega Wang et al. (2026) to recover coarse camera parameters and a global point cloud from the input RGB images. After confidence filtering and outlier removal, we align and rescale the reconstruction to the canonical scene coordinates.
We partition its X ​ Y XY bounding box into overlapping cubic blocks of side length ℓ \ell , with adjacent blocks overlapping by ℓ / 4 \ell/4 .
For each block, we retain only the in-block pixels of each input RGB image and consider images with at least 15 % 15\% in-block pixel coverage as candidate views. We voxelise the corresponding visible points and select up to V V views whose union maximises the block’s voxel coverage. This produces the training-compatible tuple ( 𝒫 ^ b , { ( I v , K ^ v , R ^ v , t ^ v ) } v = 1 V ) (\hat{\mathcal{P}}_{b},\{(I_{v},\hat{K}_{v},\hat{R}_{v},\hat{t}_{v})\}_{v=1}^{V}) , without requiring ground-truth geometry or calibrated cameras.

blocks.en: We determine a voxel-priority generation order based on block-wise voxel occupancy. Starting from the block with the highest occupancy, we greedily expand a connected frontier while ensuring that each block has at most two previously generated four-connected neighbours. This ordering matches the 1 1 - and 2 2 -neighbour masks used to train the block inpainters.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Datasets. We evaluate on unseen scenes from two datasets. From 3D-FRONT Fu et al. (2021) , we hold out 30 scenes to assess performance on synthetic data. From ScanNet++ Yeshwanth et al. (2023) , we evaluate 30 scenes to assess out-of-domain real-world performance. Each scene provides 32 unposed RGB images as input and 50 held-out RGB, depth, and normal views for evaluation.
blocks.zh: 数据集. 我们从两个数据集 在看不见的场景上评估。 从3D-FRONT Fu et al.(2021),我们持有30个场景来评估合成数据的性能. 从ScanNet++ Yeshwanth等人(2023年),我们评价了30场场景,以评估域外现实世界的表现. 每个场景提供32个未放置的RGB图像作为输入,以及50个持有的RGB,深度,以及评价的正常视图.

blocks.en: Metrics. We evaluate reconstructed meshes in both 3D and 2D. In 3D, we measure geometric accuracy and coverage using Chamfer distance (CD), F-score ( 10 10 cm), and normal consistency (NC, thresholded at 20 20 cm). In 2D, we report geometric errors (RMSE, AbsRel, and angular normal error), computed over mutually valid pixels; perceptual and semantic metrics (LPIPS and CLIP) on depth and normal renderings; and completeness over valid reference pixels.
blocks.zh: 度量衡. 我们用3D和2D来评估重建的元件。 在3D中,我们使用Chamfer距离(CD),F-score(10 10 cm)和正常一致性(NC,阈值为20 cm)测量几何精度和覆盖范围. 在2D中,我们报告几何误差(RMSE, AbsRel, 和角正常误差),通过相互有效的像素计算;关于深度和正常渲染的知觉和语义测量(LPIPS和CLIP);以及相对于有效参考像素的完整性.

blocks.en: Baselines. We compare against five representative baselines spanning different reconstruction paradigms. VGGT- Ω \Omega Wang et al. (2026) predicts per-view depth maps and camera poses, then fuses them into a mesh via TSDF integration Newcombe et al. (2011) and Marching Cubes. All of the following methods consume its predictions as input. Murre Guo et al. (2025) conditions a large monocular depth estimator on the predicted point cloud and fuses the resulting depth into a mesh. MonoSDF Yu et al. (2022) optimizes a per-scene signed distance field guided by monocular depth and normal priors. FineRecon Stier et al. (2023) performs feed-forward TSDF regression conditioned on multi-view depth guidance. GenRecon Schmid et al. (2026) tiles the scene into overlapping chunks and projects multi-view image features into per-chunk 3D feature volumes.
blocks.zh: 基线。 我们比较了跨越不同重建模式的五个有代表性的基线。 VGGT - 堆积 \ Omega Wang et al. (20 Core预测每个视图的深度图和相机摆放,然后通过 TSDF 集成 Newcombe et al. (2011) 和 Marching Cubes 将其连接成网格). 以下所有方法都消耗其预测作为投入. 墨尔郭等. (2025)在预测的点云上设置一个大单体深度估计器,并将由此形成的深度导入网格. 单 SDF Yu等人(2022年)优化了以单倍深度和正常前科为引导的单倍空间签名距离场. FineRecon Stier等人(2023年)在多视图深度引导下执行向导TSDF回归. GenRecon Schmid et al. (2026) 将场景铺平成重叠块,将多视图图像特性投射到每堆3D特性卷中.

blocks.en:
We present qualitative comparisons on both synthetic and real-world scenes in Figure 3 . As a reconstruction-based approach, VGGT- Ω \Omega +TSDF recovers visible surfaces but leaves unobserved regions incomplete. Deviations in its predicted depths and camera poses can further propagate through TSDF fusion, resulting in noisy artifacts and distorted walls.
Methods that use geometric predictions from VGGT- Ω \Omega , such as Murre and FineRecon, also exhibit artifacts and broken surfaces.
GenRecon completes some unobserved regions; however, its feature-projection conditioning mechanism injects the distorted point cloud and inaccurate camera poses into the generative model, resulting in fragmented artifacts and distortions of the global scene layout.
The optimisation-based MonoSDF completes missing regions and reduces geometric noise, but its over-smoothed surfaces lose fine geometric details.
In comparison, WorldRecon produces more complete and geometrically coherent reconstructions, preserving sharper object boundaries, thin structures, and local details despite noise in the initial geometry and camera estimates.

我们在图3中提供了合成场景和现实场景的定性比较。 作为一种基于重建的方法,VGGT - 堆积 \ Omega + TSDF 恢复可见的表面,但使未观测区域不完整。 其预测深度和相机姿势的偏移可以通过TSDF聚变进一步传播,从而产生吵闹的文物和扭曲的墙壁.
使用来自 VGGT 的几何预测的方法—— 堆积 \ Omega , 如 Murre 和 FineRecon , 也会显示文物和破损的表面 。
GenRecon完成了一些未观测的区域;然而,它的特征-预测调节机制将扭曲的点云和不准确的相机构成的摄像头注入基因模型,导致文物零散,全球场景布局扭曲.
基于优化的MonoSDF可以完成缺失区域,减少几何噪声,但其过沉的表面会失去精细的几何细节.
相比之下,WorldRecon生产更完整和几何连贯的重建,尽管最初的几何学和相机估计有噪音,但仍保留了更尖锐的物体边界,薄的结构,以及局部细节.

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.4 阅读研究

blocks.en: We ablate the key components of WorldRecon. The ablation experiments are conducted on complete scenes generated from 15 3D-FRONT scenes and 15 ScanNet++ scenes. Starting from the vanilla pretrained TRELLIS.2 Xiang et al. (2026) , we progressively add four components: reconstruction-based sparse-structure generation ( SS ), reconstruction-based geometry and material generation ( Geo+Mat ), neighbour-aware latent inpainting ( Inpaint ), and stage-wise world latent clamping and blending ( Stitch ). Quantitative results are reported in Table 3 , while Figure 4 visualizes the corresponding effects on representative scene structures and local details.
blocks.zh: 我们放弃了WorldRecon的关键部分. 在15个3D-FRONT场景和15个ScanNet++场景产生的完整场景上进行了消融实验. 从香草预训TRELLIS2开始. Xiang等人(2026年),我们逐渐增加了四个组成部分:基于重建的零星结构生成(SS),基于重建的几何学和材料生成(Geo+Mat),邻里认识的潜在涂料(Inpaint),以及基于阶段的世界潜在夹击和混合(Stitch). 表3中报告了定量结果,图4则将相应的效果可视化到代表性场景结构和局部细节.

blocks.en:
Although vanilla pretrained TRELLIS.2 has been trained on 3D-FRONT scene data, it performs poorly in our task because its single-image conditioning provides only partial observations and does not enforce a consistent world orientation. Our reconstruction-based SS generator instead uses the reconstructed point cloud as a spatial prior while leveraging the generative prior to plausibly complete regions missing from the initial reconstruction. Our reconstruction-based Geo&Mat generators further exploit multi-view observations to recover finer geometry and more faithful materials. Nevertheless, because the blocks are generated independently, inconsistencies can remain in their overlapping regions. As shown in Figure 4 , adjacent blocks may exhibit misaligned surface heights at their interfaces, accompanied by visible discontinuities in geometry and texture. Adding Inpaint propagates context between neighbouring blocks, encouraging their surfaces to connect coherently and improving the depth and normal metrics. However, small inconsistencies at block boundaries may remain visible as seams, explaining the slight degradation in the 3D metrics reported in Table 3 .
The complete WorldRecon pipeline employs stage-wise world latent clamping and blending ( Stitch ) to maintain cross-block continuity and global scene coherence, thereby eliminating visible boundary discontinuities. It consequently achieves the best performance across all reported metrics and produces the reconstruction most consistent with the ground truth.
blocks.zh:
虽然香草预训的TRELLIS.2已经接受了3D-FRONT场景数据的培训,但是它的工作表现不佳,因为它的单像调制只提供了部分的观察,没有执行一致的世界导向. 我们的基于重建的SS生成器将重建的点云作为空间前置,同时在初步重建中缺失的可信完整的区域之前利用基因。 我们基于重建的Geo & Mat发电机进一步利用多视图观测,以回收更精细的几何和更加忠实的材料。 然而,由于区块是独立产生的,相互重叠的区域仍然可能存在不一致之处。 如图4所示,相邻区块可能在其界面上显示错位的表面高度,同时伴有几何和纹理的明显不连续. 添加Inpaint在相邻区块之间传播环境,鼓励其表面连贯连接,并改善深度和正常度量. 然而,区块边界上存在的小幅不一致可能仍然作为接合物而存在,这解释了表3中报告的3D度测量值的轻微降解。
完整的WorldRecon管道采用阶段性的世界潜在夹击和混合(Stitch),以保持跨块的连续性和全球场景的一致性,从而消除明显的边界不连续。 因此,它在所有报告的指标方面都取得了最佳业绩,并进行了最符合实地真相的重建。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented WorldRecon, a generative reconstruction framework for recovering complete, large-scale scene PBR meshes from unposed RGB images. WorldRecon leverages coarse geometry and camera estimates predicted by a reconstruction model as effective global grounding despite their imperfections. Based on this global scaffold, reconstruction-based block generation produces faithful mesh blocks with detailed geometry and PBR materials. Neighbour-aware latent inpainting and the causal world-generation pipeline stitch these blocks together, ensuring consistent transitions across block boundaries. WorldRecon achieves state-of-the-art performance in large-scale indoor scene reconstruction, with strong sim-to-real generalization despite training exclusively on synthetic data. More broadly, our work provides a practical path toward reconstructing editable 3D scene assets from casually captured or generated videos, supporting downstream applications such as simulation, embodied AI, and content creation.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了WorldRecon, 一个基因重建框架, 以恢复完整的,大规模的场景 PBR meshes 从没有的RGB图像。 WorldRecon利用了粗糙的几何学和相机估计,通过重建模型的预测是有效的全球地面,尽管其不完善. 基于这个全球脚手架,基于重建的块生成会产生忠实的网状块,带有详细的几何和PBR材料. 邻居认识的潜在涂料和世界代的因果管道将这些块缝合在一起,确保跨越区块界限的持续过渡。 WorldRecon在大规模室内场景重建中实现了最先进的性能,尽管只接受了合成数据方面的培训,但还是有强烈的sim-to-realization. 更广义地说,我们的工作提供了一条实用的道路,从随机捕获或生成的视频中重建可编辑的3D场景资产,支持模拟,内含AI,内容创建等下游应用.

blocks.en: Limitations and Future Work. As our training data comprise only indoor scenes, the current applicability of WorldRecon is limited to indoor environments, and its generalization to outdoor scenes remains to be established. In addition, our current scene representation comprises a single layer of 4 ​ m 4\,\mathrm{m} -high blocks, restricting reconstruction to single-story environments and precluding the modeling of multi-story buildings. Extending the training distribution to more diverse indoor, outdoor, and multi-story environments, together with supporting block generation along the vertical dimension, constitutes an important direction for future work.
blocks.zh: 限制和今后的工作。 由于我们的培训数据仅包括室内场景,因此目前WorldRecon的应用仅限于室内环境,其对室外场景的泛化仍有待确定. 此外,我们目前的场景表现包括一个4m 4\,\mathrm{m}-高块的单层,将重建限制在单层环境,排除多层建筑的建模. 将培训分布扩大到更加多样化的室内、室外和多层环境,以及支持纵向的区块生成,是今后工作的一个重要方向。

blocks.en:
We use VGGT- Ω \Omega Wang et al. (2026) prediction as the common geometric prior for all methods. It provides camera intrinsics and extrinsics, per-view depth and confidence, and a point cloud obtained by unprojecting the predicted depths. Each baseline follows its official pipeline, with any required ground-truth geometric inputs replaced by the corresponding
predictions from VGGT- Ω \Omega . • VGGT- Ω \Omega +TSDF directly integrates the predicted RGB-D
frames using the VGGT- Ω \Omega cameras through TSDF
fusion Newcombe et al. (2011) . • Murre Guo et al. (2025) receives the RGB frames and sparse depth
samples selected from the VGGT- Ω \Omega depth maps using confidence,
spatial subsampling, and multi-view consistency. Its refined dense depths
are fused with the VGGT- Ω \Omega intrinsics and aligned poses using TSDF. • FineRecon Stier et al. (2023) receives the RGB frames,

blocks.en: C.2 Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: C.2 评价议定书

blocks.en: As VGGT- Ω \Omega estimates camera poses from uncalibrated images, its reconstructed coordinate frame has no absolute scale or canonical horizontal orientation. Our scene-alignment procedure recovers gravity and dominant wall directions, but does not resolve the remaining global similarity ambiguity with respect to the ground-truth frame. For evaluation, we therefore estimate a Sim(3) transform from corresponding predicted and reference camera centres using Horn alignment and apply it to the complete predicted mesh. The same transform is used for all 2D and 3D metrics. We convert dataset-specific axis conventions before computing the metrics.
blocks.zh: 由于 VGGT - 堆叠 \ Omega 估计相机来自未校准的图像, 其交配的坐标框没有绝对的尺度或线条水平方向 。 我们的场景调整程序恢复了重力和主要墙面方向,但并没有解决在地面真相框架方面仍然存在的全球相似性模糊问题。 为了评估,我们估计Sim(3)从使用Horn对齐的相应预测和参考相机中心进行转换,并将其应用于完整的预测网格。 所有2D和3D度量衡都使用相同的变换. 我们先转换特定数据集的轴线常规,然后计算指标。

blocks.en: Following the evaluation protocol of GenRecon Schmid et al. (2026) , for synthetic scenes, we restrict prediction triangles to the GT axis-aligned bounding box enlarged by 20 % 20\% , preventing geometry far outside the scene extent from dominating the evaluation. For ScanNet++, we restrict the evaluation domain to the observed scanner surface, represented by a 1.1 ​ cm 1.1\,\mathrm{cm} voxel grid and dilated by 15 ​ cm 15\,\mathrm{cm} .

blocks.en: D.1 Large Scene Generation

blocks.en: We further demonstrate our method on large-scale indoor scenes comprising multiple, largely isolated rooms. As shown in Fig. S1 , our method reconstructs an expansive nine-room scene with high fidelity, demonstrating its scalability to large 3D indoor environments.

blocks.en: Figure S2: Comparison with Agentic Baseline. Given the same 32 views, we show GT, ours, and a GPT-6 Astra agent adapted from BVB Tang et al. (2026) (left to right). Our method yields more faithful reconstructions, while the agent simplifies or omits objects and distorts the scene layout.

blocks.en: D.2 Comparison with Agentic Baseline.
blocks.zh: D.2 与代理基线的比较。

blocks.en: We compare our method with a GPT-6 Astra agent configured with high reasoning effort and adapted from BVB’s reconstruction protocol Tang et al. (2026) . Given the same 32 RGB views, the agent inspects the images, writes and executes Blender scripts, and examines rendered previews to refine its reconstruction. It constructs scenes using geometric primitives and materials specified by numerical parameters, without image textures or imported assets. Our adaptation uses fixed RGB views instead of video input and does not enforce the original cost ceiling.
blocks.zh: 我们把方法与GPT-6 Astra 剂比较, 鉴于同样32个RGB视图,代理商检查图像,写和执行Blender脚本,并检查渲染的预览以完善其重建. 它使用几何原始物和数字参数指定的材料构造场景,没有图像纹理或输入资产. 我们的改编使用固定的RGB视图,而不是视频输入,并且不执行原成本上限.

blocks.en:
Figure S2 shows a densely furnished scene with complex object arrangements and mutual occlusions (top), and a multi-room interior with oblique partitions (bottom). The recorded reconstruction stages consume approximately 2.12M and 1.71M tokens, respectively, including repeated cached context, corresponding to estimated Standard API-equivalent costs of $2.93 and $2.26. In contrast, our method performs inference on a single GPU without external LLM calls, avoiding this additional API expense.
Despite iterative refinement, the agent produces simplified object geometry and misplaced furniture. In the multi-room scene, it reconstructs an incorrect global layout. Our method more faithfully recovers furniture arrangement, architectural structure, and surface appearance.
blocks.zh:
图S2显示布局密集的场景,有复杂的物体安排和相互隔离(顶部),多室室内有斜隔(底部). 所记录的重建阶段分别消耗约2.12M和1.71M令牌,包括反复缓存的上下文,相当于估计的标准API等值费用2.93美元和2.26美元. 相比之下,我们的方法是对一个没有外部LLM呼叫的单一GPU进行推论,避免了这种额外的API费用.
尽管进行了迭代的完善,该剂仍然生产简化对象几何和错位家具. 在多室场景中,它重建了一个不正确的全球布局. 我们的方法更忠实地恢复家具安排,建筑结构,以及表面外观.

blocks.en: D.3 Failure Cases and Limitations
blocks.zh: D.3 失败案件和限制

blocks.en: Figure S3 illustrates a representative failure case on a multi-room scene. The 32 sampled input views (top-left) are visually rich, but parts of the scene are occluded or observed from only a handful of viewpoints. As a result, the VGGT- Ω \Omega point-cloud scaffold (bottom-left) incorrectly estimates the poses of several views: some regions are either left unreconstructed or filtered out due to low confidence, while other views are projected to entirely wrong locations.
blocks.zh: 图S3显示一个多房间场景中的代表性故障案例。 32个采样的输入视图(左上方)是视觉丰富的,但部分场景只是从少数角度来观察或观察. 因此,VGGT - 堆积 \Omega 点- 点- 积层脚手架( 堆积- 左) 错误地估计了几种观点的外观: 有些区域由于信任度低而被忽略或过滤出去, 而另一些观点则被预测为完全错误的位置 。

blocks.en:
Under this shared scaffold, the TSDF baseline can only reconstruct a small fraction of the
scene, while the generative baseline GenRecon directly reprojects image features using the erroneous poses, scattering misaligned projections across the scene and producing large fragmented artifacts as well as distorted objects.
WorldRecon likewise suffers from missing geometry in unobserved regions
due to the incomplete input coverage. Nevertheless, it remains
robust to substantial pose errors and still faithfully reconstructs the areas
that are well covered by the input views, and is able to hallucinate plausible completions for the missing point-cloud regions based on sparse image cues.
blocks.zh:
在这个共享脚手架下,TSDF基线只能重建一小部分
,而基因基线GenRecon则利用错误的姿势直接重新投影图像特征,将投影错位分散到整个场景,并产生大量破碎的文物和扭曲的物体.
世界重建组织同样在未观测到的地区缺少几何特征
由于输入覆盖范围不完整。 尽管如此,它仍然
强势至重大错误,仍然忠实地重建这些地区
并且能够根据微小的图像提示,对缺失的点-云区域产生幻觉。
